---
name: Social Media Growth Rules
description: "Use when planning or operating Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, Meta Business API integrations, social analytics, content systems, or organic growth experiments tied to business conversion."
---
# Social Media Growth Rules

- Treat Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp as channel adapters around an authoritative product and data core; do not let social copy drift away from actual offer, pricing, onboarding flow, or compliance posture.
- Use Meta Business permissions, app review scopes, token storage, webhook verification, and asset ownership explicitly; never assume access exists just because a page or account is visible.
- Define target persona, funnel stage, CTA, success metric, hypothesis, and attribution path before launching a content change or experiment.
- Prefer organic growth experiments first; do not default to paid media when the stated objective is unpaid reach, engagement, and conversion.
- Separate organic reach, lifecycle messaging, support messaging, and paid media in both strategy and measurement.
- Use stable post IDs, reel IDs, UTM conventions, and time-windowed snapshots so performance data can be audited and compared later.
- Store raw social insights append-only before producing derived KPIs, rankings, or recommendations.
- For WhatsApp, respect opt-in posture, template constraints, contact frequency limits, and human escalation paths.
- For Facebook page misdirection or ownership issues, verify Business Manager ownership, page username, linked assets, Instagram connection, domain verification, and canonical URLs before editing content or automation.
- Recommend content patterns that match each network's algorithm and user behavior, but keep claims accurate, privacy-safe, and brand-consistent.
- Prefer experiments that can be reversed quickly and evaluated with explicit stopping criteria.
